gsm_gen_ai_sub_check = {
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 0 }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 2 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_minerals = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 3 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_food = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 5 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_consumer_goods = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 6 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_alloys = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 7 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_physics_research = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 8 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_society_research = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 9 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_engineering_research = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 10 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_unity = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 11 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_influence = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 12 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_media = yes } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }

	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 15 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_military = yes owner = { has_policy_flag = gsm_dout_on } } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_ai value = 16 } } if = { limit = { gsm_gen_sub_security = yes owner = { has_policy_flag = gsm_dout_on } } set_variable = { which = gsm_t_asub value = 1 } } }

gsm_gen_branch_count = {
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_bn value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_bc value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_bx value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_un value = 0 }
	set_variable = { which = gsm_t_jok value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_k_energy check_variable = { which = gsm_k_energy value > 0 } }
		change_variable = { which = gsm_t_bn value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_holding = { holding = gsm_branch_energy owner = event_target:gsm_exchange } } change_variable = { which = gsm_t_bc value = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_holding = { holding = gsm_branch_energy owner = event_target:gsm_exchange } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_set = gsm_kx_energy check_variable = { which = gsm_kx_energy value > 0 } } } } change_variable = { which = gsm_t_bx value = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_bu_energy check_variable = { which = gsm_bu_energy value > 0 } is_variable_set = gsm_jv_energy }
		change_variable = { which = gsm_t_un value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_jv_energy value = 1 } }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = count_owned_workforce parameters = { limit = { has_job_type = technician } } variable = gsm_t_jx }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = free_jobs_of_type parameters = { job = technician include_deprioritized_jobs = yes } variable = gsm_t_jy }
			change_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = gsm_t_jy }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_jv_energy value = 2 } }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = count_owned_workforce parameters = { limit = { has_job_type = technician_drone } } variable = gsm_t_jx }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = free_jobs_of_type parameters = { job = technician_drone include_deprioritized_jobs = yes } variable = gsm_t_jy }
			change_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = gsm_t_jy }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_jv_energy value = 3 } }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = count_owned_workforce parameters = { limit = { has_job_type = technician_drone } } variable = gsm_t_jx }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = free_jobs_of_type parameters = { job = technician_drone include_deprioritized_jobs = yes } variable = gsm_t_jy }
			change_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = gsm_t_jy }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value > 0 } } change_variable = { which = gsm_t_jok value = 1 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_k_minerals check_variable = { which = gsm_k_minerals value > 0 } }
		change_variable = { which = gsm_t_bn value = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_holding = { holding = gsm_branch_minerals owner = event_target:gsm_exchange } } change_variable = { which = gsm_t_bc value = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_holding = { holding = gsm_branch_minerals owner = event_target:gsm_exchange } NOT = { AND = { is_variable_set = gsm_kx_minerals check_variable = { which = gsm_kx_minerals value > 0 } } } } change_variable = { which = gsm_t_bx value = 1 } }
	if = {
		limit = { is_variable_set = gsm_bu_minerals check_variable = { which = gsm_bu_minerals value > 0 } is_variable_set = gsm_jv_minerals }
		change_variable = { which = gsm_t_un value = 1 }
		set_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_jv_minerals value = 1 } }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = count_owned_workforce parameters = { limit = { has_job_type = miner } } variable = gsm_t_jx }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = free_jobs_of_type parameters = { job = miner include_deprioritized_jobs = yes } variable = gsm_t_jy }
			change_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = gsm_t_jy }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_jv_minerals value = 2 } }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = count_owned_workforce parameters = { limit = { has_job_type = mining_drone } } variable = gsm_t_jx }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = free_jobs_of_type parameters = { job = mining_drone include_deprioritized_jobs = yes } variable = gsm_t_jy }
			change_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = gsm_t_jy }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { which = gsm_jv_minerals value = 3 } }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = count_owned_workforce parameters = { limit = { has_job_type = mining_drone } } variable = gsm_t_jx }
			export_trigger_value_to_variable = { trigger = free_jobs_of_type parameters = { job = mining_drone include_deprioritized_jobs = yes } variable = gsm_t_jy }
			change_variable = { which = gsm_t_jx value = gsm_t_jy }
		}
